_comment: FlowHub routing table: which local repository each YouTrack project drives.
_comment_usage: Copy to ~/.config/flowhub/config.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/flowhub/config.json when set) and replace every placeholder below; that is the default path, and FLOWHUB_PROJECTS_FILE overrides it. This file in the repository is NOT loaded by default.
_comment_why: This mapping cannot be read from YouTrack: the webhook payload carries only {key, name, shortName}, and YouTrack exposes no REST field or endpoint for the VCS-integration repository URL. Routing is therefore declared here, and an unmapped project is refused rather than guessed.
_comment_matching: youtrack_key is matched against the payload's project.key, case-insensitively. If a payload carries no project object, the prefix of the issue ID (TEST-11 -> TEST) is used as a fallback. A project key that is present but unmapped is a hard miss.
_comment_startup: Validation runs before any file is created: every path must exist, look like a git work tree, and match repo.remote. A problem stops the process. Leave 'remote' empty to skip only the remote comparison. A *disabled* entry is skipped entirely, which is why the placeholder below is disabled.

projects._comment: One entry per repository. Several YouTrack projects may share a repository through also_keys.

repo._comment: path must be absolute and is canonicalised on load (symlinks resolved), because opencode treats /tmp and /private/tmp as different projects. remote is compared against .git/config so that a typo cannot route work into the wrong clone.

projects._comment_worktrees: Base directory for the one-git-worktree-per-task isolation. Must be absolute and outside repo.path. Created on demand, so it does not have to exist yet. Required once dispatch is on (FLOWHUB_DISPATCH=1), unless the global FLOWHUB_WORKTREE_BASE provides a fallback.
projects._comment_agent: Passed to opencode when the task session is created; it wins over FLOWHUB_DISPATCH_AGENT. Leave model empty to use the agent's own default.
projects._comment_authors: Optional per-project author allowlist (YouTrack logins, case-insensitive). Empty means every actor the routing matches; a non-empty list gets no work from anyone it does not name. issueDeleted carries no actor, so a project with an allowlist can never act on one.
projects._comment_enabled: enabled defaults to true. A disabled entry is never matched and is not validated, so it may point at a checkout this host does not have.
